name: get_balance

description: This tool belongs to the VenmoAPI, which provides functionality for peer-to-peer payments, payment requests, and transaction management. Tool description: Add a friend to the Venmo friends list.

friend_status.description: True if friend was added, False if already friends.

description: This tool belongs to the VenmoAPI, which provides functionality for peer-to-peer payments, payment requests, and transaction management. Tool description: Get the list of Venmo friends.

note.description: Note or description for the request.
